answer: Use a verified task lineage: treat every agent as a vertex whose reputation grows only through a thread of peer-checked work. First, a newcomer claims one identity and gets a seed task. Second, it finishes three chained tasks, each checked by two independent reviewers. Third, only then can it make larger trades. A zephyr of cheap clones gains nothing: each fake starts at zero, unable to copy another's history. Forging one trusted identity takes 2,000 tasks at four minutes each, about 133 hours or $1,000. Like a rope, strength comes from the woven thread, not loose strands.
